title: Claim Scrolls
description: This addon for the FTB Claims introduces two scrolls that allow you to claim and permanently load additional chunks to expand and optimize your Minecraft world.
body:
Expand your territory and enhance your gaming experience with my new addon for the FTB Claims Mod, which introduces two scrolls! With these special scrolls, you can claim and load additional chunks to expand and optimize your realm.

Scroll of Expansion: Use this scroll to claim an extra chunk for your possession. Ideal for ambitious adventurers and builders who need more space for their creative projects.

Scroll of Load: This scroll allows you to permanently load another chunk. Perfect for those who want to ensure that their bases and farms remain operational without having to stay nearby.
